The issuer exhibits a solid balance sheet with total assets of $11.31 billion and equity of $3.86 billion, alongside profitable operations reflected by an EBIT of $436 million and net income of $242 million (EBIT margin ~20.2%). However, a moderate leverage profile (total liabilities to assets of ~65.9%) and a constrained short-term liquidity position, with current assets of $674 million against current liabilities of $932 million (current ratio of 0.72), balance these strengths. Overall, these credit metrics align with an investment-grade rating in the BBB category.

DECISION: BBB
